article.title: Claude Ship加入修復與批准代理，團隊可先用僅觀察模式
article.title_en: Claude Ship adds repair and approval agents with an observe-first option
article.summary: Anthropic推出Claude Ship，結合程式碼審查，以及仍在測試的修復與批准代理，依團隊政策處理拉取請求。
article.summary_en: Anthropic launched Claude Ship, combining code review with beta repair and approval agents governed by team policy.
highlights: PR Steward可處理失敗檢查及合併衝突，本身不批准或合併變更。
Claude Approvals讀取儲存庫政策；官方建議先以僅觀察模式啟用。
highlights_en: PR Steward addresses failing checks and merge conflicts without approving or merging changes.
Claude Approvals reads repository policy; Anthropic recommends starting in observe-only mode.
article.why: 製作活動網站或行銷工具的團隊，可把修復與批准拆開管理，決定哪些例行變更交予代理、哪些仍由負責人簽核。
article.why_en: Teams building campaign sites can separate repairs from approval and define which routine changes still need an accountable reviewer.
article.next_step: 在測試網站的儲存庫列出一類低影響變更，讓批准代理先記錄判斷，再與團隊實際決定逐筆比較。
article.next_step_en: Define one low-impact change type in a test-site repository and compare observe-only approval decisions with the team's actual reviews.
article.detail: 服務適用於Claude Team及Enterprise的GitHub儲存庫。PR是提出程式變更供團隊審查的拉取請求，持續集成檢查則用來驗證建置及測試。Ship按用量計費，管理員可設定部分開支上限；使用零資料保留、HIPAA設定或客戶管理加密金鑰的組織不適用。自動批准仍須符合儲存庫規則，不能視為品質保證。
article.detail_en: Ship supports GitHub repositories on Claude Team and Enterprise. A pull request proposes code changes, while CI checks build and test them. Usage is billed in tokens, with selected spending controls. Organizations using Zero Data Retention, HIPAA configuration or customer-managed encryption keys are excluded. Repository rules still govern approval.
